value.rationale: This supplies the first mathematically sharp obstruction to saturating the primitive-necklace packing bound for fixed-weight-four binary synchronization codes: equality through n=11 and strict one-orbit deficiency at n=12. The upper bound has a nontrivial global clique-partition certificate, rather than being a direct substitution, primitive-word count, or routine increment of the weight-three theorem. Matching codebooks demonstrate attainability, and the finite classification is reproducible without a solver.
